plan.t: Traducción y huecos hasta acertar casi todo.

Los ejercicios de clase sin mirar.

qs.q: Which sentence uses can to describe a present ability?
A student wants to ask a friend for a ride home. Which sentence uses can to make the request?
What does can't express in the sentence “She can't pass the exam”?
Which sentence correctly uses be able to for a future ability?
o: I will be able to finish it.

qs.q: Which sentence uses could to describe an ability in the past?
You want to give a classmate friendly advice in a polite way. Which sentence is the best choice?
Which modal verb best completes this polite request: “___ I use your phone?”
o: Have to I use your phone?

qs.q: A student is unsure whether Javier Bardem will attend a party, and the possibility seems fairly remote. Which sentence expresses this meaning most accurately?
o: Javier Bardem may go to the party.
Javier Bardem might go to the party.
Javier Bardem must go to the party.
Javier Bardem has to go to the party.

qs.q: Which sentence uses must to show certainty that something is true rather than an obligation?
o: Your father must be very angry.
Your father must tidy his bedroom.
Your father must not tell a lie.

qs.q: Which sentence correctly expresses an obligation or necessity?
o: You have to tidy your bedroom.
You don't have to tidy your bedroom.

qs.q: A teacher wants to forbid students from lying. Which sentence communicates prohibition?
Which sentence means that saying anything is optional, so there is no obligation to speak?
o: You don't have to say anything.

qs.q: Which modal expression shows that an action is necessary or obligatory?
Which sentence correctly expresses a lack of obligation?
o: I need to wait for them.
I ought to wait for them.

qs.q: What is the main difference between “need to” and “needn’t”?
o: “Need to” shows necessity; “needn’t” shows no obligation.
“Need to” shows no obligation; “needn’t” shows necessity.
“Need to” gives negative advice; “needn’t” gives positive advice.

qs.q: A student is worried about a disagreement with a friend. Which sentence gives appropriate advice?
o: You needn’t talk to your friend.
You shouldn’t talk to your friend.
You should talk to your friend.
You need to avoid your friend.

qs.q: A classmate is about to laugh at someone and tell that person a lie. Which advice best follows the rules for negative advice?
o: You need to laugh and lie to him.
You needn’t laugh or lie to him.
You should laugh but shouldn’t lie to him.
You shouldn’t laugh or lie to him.

qs.q: Repeated failed authentication attempts have been detected. What should the team do first according to the recommended response?
o: Identify large files and confirm backup status.
Review the affected account and verify the source.
Assess the impact and follow recovery procedures.

qs.q: Storage is almost full. Which pair of actions best addresses the stated risk?
o: Check DNS status and compare DNS settings.
Identify large files and confirm backup status.
Review the account and verify the login source.
Renew the certificate and document the steps.

qs.q: A backup job has failed. Which response is most appropriate?
o: Verify the error message and confirm a recent valid backup.
Check the service status and review recent system changes.
Identify large files and compare configured DNS settings.
Assess the impact and grant permissions to users.

qs.q: Users cannot access a shared folder. Which cause should be investigated first according to the recommended phrasing?
o: A certificate expiry or browser warning
A failed backup or missing database
A DNS service or patching issue

qs.q: A certificate will expire soon. Which plan best reduces the risk of browser warnings or interrupted access?
o: Schedule renewal before expiry and document the steps.
Review the account and verify the authentication source.
Check resource usage and investigate workload changes.
Compare DNS settings and confirm the service status.

qs.q: A virtual machine has become slow, but the cause is unknown. Which troubleshooting approach is recommended?
o: Isolate the problem by checking resource usage and workload changes.
Restore the database and confirm that a backup is available.
Renew the certificate and document the recovery procedure.
Compare DNS settings and review the affected user account.

qs.q: A DNS service is failing. Which investigation best matches the recommended response?
o: Verify service status and compare configured DNS settings.
Identify large files and confirm the recent backup status.
Review the affected account and verify the login source.
Assess the impact and follow the approved recovery procedure.

qs.q: An unexpected issue began after a patch was installed. What should the team do next?
o: Assess the impact and follow the approved recovery procedure.
Schedule certificate renewal and document the technical steps.
Identify large files and verify the backup job status.
Check the affected account and compare its permissions.

qs.q: A client requests a technical explanation, but only one service is affected while the rest of the platform remains available. What communication is recommended?
o: Provide an update after the next verification.
Announce that the entire platform is unavailable.
Ask all users to change their passwords immediately.
Restore the database before checking the service.
